verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents an audit log that records who changed the cap table, what changed, when, or under what authorization. The nearby features are different capabilities: importing historical transactions, API delta sync of changed rows, and permission segmentation. None of them is a change audit trail, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, every change to the cap table is captured in an audit log — who changed what, when, and under what authorization
